meta.conf_convention: sum over estimation set of company total scored reviews as of window end
meta.turnover_definition: one-way: |names added to Q1| / |Q1|, averaged over rebalances
meta.variant_a_caveat: Variant A is NOT free of look-ahead: every evaluation quarter lies inside at least one estimation window that fed the average. It is a robustness comparison, not the honest benchmark; Variant W is the walk-forward (honest) variant.
